<DESCRIPTION>CONVERTIBLE DEBENTURE BETWEEN THE VIRAL GENETICS, INC. AND ROBERT SIEGEL, DATED AUGUST 11, 2012
<TEXT>

<HEAD>
     <TITLE></TITLE>
</HEAD>
<BODY STYLE="font: 10pt Times New Roman, Times, Serif">

<P STYLE="margin: 0"><B>Exhibit 10.87</B></P>

<P STYLE="margin: 0">&nbsp;</P>

<P STYLE="margin: 0"></P>

<P STYLE="font: 10pt Times New Roman, Times, Serif; margin: 0pt 0; text-align: justify"><B>THIS DEBENTURE AND THE SECURITIES ISSUABLE
UPON CONVERSION OF THIS DEBENTURE HAVE NOT BEEN REGISTERED UNDER THE SECURITIES ACT OF<I> </I>1933, AS AMENDED (THE &quot;SECURITIES
ACT&quot;), OR ANY STATE SECURITIES LAW, AND MAY NOT BE OFFERED FOR SALE OR SOLD UNLESS A REGISTRATION STATEMENT UNDER SUCH ACT
AND APPLICABLE STATE SECURITIES LAWS SHALL BE EFFECTIVE WITH RESPECT THERETO OR AN EXEMPTION FROM REGISTRATION UNDER THE SECURITIES
ACT AND APPLICABLE STATE SECURITIES LAWS IS AVAILABLE IN CONNECTION WITH SUCH OFFER OR SALE. THIS DEBENTURE DOES NOT REQUIRE PHYSICAL
SURRENDER  HEREOF IN ORDER TO EFFECT A PARTIAL PAYMENT, REDEMPTION OR CONVERSION HEREOF. ACCORDINGLY, THE OUTSTANDING PRINCIPAL
AMOUNT OF THIS DEBENTURE MAY BE LESS THAN THE PRINCIPAL AMOUNT SHOWN BELOW.</B></P>

<P STYLE="font: 10pt Times New Roman, Times, Serif; margin: 0pt 0; text-align: justify">&nbsp;</P>

<P STYLE="font: 10pt Times New Roman, Times, Serif; margin: 0pt 0; text-align: center"><B>VIRAL GENETICS, INC.</B></P>

<P STYLE="font: 10pt Times New Roman, Times, Serif; margin: 0pt 0; text-align: center">&nbsp;</P>

<P STYLE="font: 10pt Times New Roman, Times, Serif; margin: 0pt 0; text-align: center"><B>UNSECURED CONVERTIBLE DEBENTURE</B></P>

<P STYLE="font: 10pt Times New Roman, Times, Serif; margin: 0pt 0; text-align: center">&nbsp;</P>

<table cellspacing="0" cellpadding="0" style="font: 10pt Times New Roman, Times, Serif; width: 100%; border-collapse: collapse">
<tr style="vertical-align: top">
    <TD STYLE="width: 82%; padding-right: 5.4pt; font-size: 10pt"><b>San Marino, California</b></td>
    <TD STYLE="width: 18%; padding-left: 5.4pt; font-size: 10pt; text-align: right"><b>$150,000</b></td></tr>
</table>
<P STYLE="font: 10pt Times New Roman, Times, Serif; margin: 0pt 0"><B>Issue Date: August 11, 2012</B></P>

<P STYLE="font: 10pt Times New Roman, Times, Serif; margin: 0pt 0">&nbsp;</P>

<P STYLE="font: 10pt Times New Roman, Times, Serif; margin: 0pt 0; text-indent: 20pt"><B>FOR VALUE RECEIVED, </B>VIRAL GENETICS,
INC., a Delaware corporation (the <I>&quot;<B>Company</B>&quot;), </I>hereby promises to pay to the order of the Dr. Robert Siegel,
or his permitted successors or assigns (the <I>&quot;<B>Holder</B>&quot;) </I>the Principal (as hereinafter defined), in same
day funds, on or before August 11, 2013 (the <I>&quot;<B>Maturity Date</B>&quot;). </I>The<B> </B>Holder may convert amounts of
this Debenture into shares <I>(&quot;<B>Conversion Shares</B>&quot;) </I>of the Company's common stock, par value $0.0001 per
share (the <I>&quot;<B>Common Stock</B>&quot;), </I>on  the terms and subject to the conditions set forth herein.</P>

<P STYLE="font: 10pt Times New Roman, Times, Serif; margin: 0pt 0">&nbsp;</P>

<P STYLE="font: 10pt Times New Roman, Times, Serif; margin: 0pt 0; text-align: justify; text-indent: 20pt">The Principal shall be equal to the sum
of (a) one hundred and fifty thousand dollars ($150,000), to be delivered in cash to Holder prior to execution hereof. The Company's
obligations under the Debenture, including without limitation its obligation to make payments of principal thereof, are unsecured.</P>

<P STYLE="font: 10pt Times New Roman, Times, Serif; margin: 0pt 0; text-align: justify">&nbsp;</P>

<P STYLE="font: 10pt Times New Roman, Times, Serif; margin: 0pt 0"><FONT STYLE="font-size: 10pt">1<I>. </I></FONT><I><U>DEFINITIONS</U>.</I></P>

<P STYLE="font: 10pt Times New Roman, Times, Serif; margin: 0pt 0">&nbsp;</P>

<P STYLE="font: 10pt Times New Roman, Times, Serif; margin: 0pt 0; text-indent: 20pt"><I>&quot;<B>Conversion Price</B>&quot; </I>means .001 per Unit.</P>

<P STYLE="font: 10pt Times New Roman, Times, Serif; margin: 0pt 0; text-indent: 20pt">&nbsp;</P>

<P STYLE="font: 10pt Times New Roman, Times, Serif; margin: 0pt 0; text-indent: 20pt"><I>&quot;<B>Default Interest Rate</B>&quot; </I>means fourteen
percent (14%).</P>

<P STYLE="font: 10pt Times New Roman, Times, Serif; margin: 0pt 0; text-indent: 20pt">&nbsp;</P>

<P STYLE="font: 10pt Times New Roman, Times, Serif; margin: 0pt 0; text-align: justify; text-indent: 20pt"><I>&quot;<B>Person</B>&quot; </I>means
any individual, corporation, trust, association, company, partnership, joint venture, limited liability company, joint stock company,
or other entity.</P>

<P STYLE="font: 10pt Times New Roman, Times, Serif; margin: 0pt 0; text-align: justify; text-indent: 20pt">&nbsp;</P>

<P STYLE="font: 10pt Times New Roman, Times, Serif; margin: 0pt 0; text-align: justify; text-indent: 20pt"><I>&quot;<B>Trading Day</B>&quot; </I>means
a day on which shares of Common Stock is quoted for trading on a recognized stock market.</P>

<P STYLE="font: 10pt Times New Roman, Times, Serif; margin: 0pt 0; text-align: justify; text-indent: 20pt">&nbsp;</P>

<P STYLE="font: 10pt Times New Roman, Times, Serif; margin: 0pt 0; text-indent: 20pt"><FONT STYLE="font-size: 10pt"><I>&quot;<B>Unit</B>&quot; </I></FONT>means
a Unit of Common Shares.</P>

<P STYLE="font: 10pt Times New Roman, Times, Serif; margin: 0pt 0">&nbsp;</P>

<P STYLE="font: 10pt Times New Roman, Times, Serif; margin: 0pt 0"></P>

<!-- Field: Page; Sequence: 1 -->
    <DIV STYLE="margin-top: 12pt; margin-bottom: 6pt; border-bottom: Black 1pt solid"><TABLE CELLPADDING="0" CELLSPACING="0" STYLE="width: 100%; font: 10pt Times New Roman, Times, Serif"><TR><TD STYLE="text-align: center; width: 100%"><!-- Field: Sequence; Type: Arabic; Name: PageNo -->1<!-- Field: /Sequence --></TD></TR></TABLE></DIV>
    <DIV STYLE="page-break-before: always; margin-top: 6pt; margin-bottom: 12pt"><TABLE CELLPADDING="0" CELLSPACING="0" STYLE="width: 100%; font: 10pt Times New Roman, Times, Serif"><TR><TD STYLE="text-align: center; width: 100%">&nbsp;</TD></TR></TABLE></DIV>
    <!-- Field: /Page -->

<P STYLE="font: 10pt Times New Roman, Times, Serif; margin: 0pt 0">&nbsp;</P>

<P STYLE="font: 10pt Times New Roman, Times, Serif; margin: 0pt 0; text-align: justify; text-indent: 20pt">All definitions contained in this Debenture
are equally applicable to the singular and plural forms of the terms defined. The words &quot;hereof&quot;, &quot;herein&quot;
and &quot;hereunder&quot; and words of similar import referring to this Debenture refer to this Debenture as a whole and not to
any particular provision of this Debenture.</P>

<P STYLE="font: 10pt Times New Roman, Times, Serif; margin: 0pt 0; text-align: justify">&nbsp;</P>

<P STYLE="font: 10pt Times New Roman, Times, Serif; margin: 0pt 0"><FONT STYLE="font: 10pt Times New Roman, Times, Serif"><I>&#9;2.&#9;</I></FONT><I><U>PAY</U></I><U>MENT</U>.</P>

<P STYLE="font: 10pt Times New Roman, Times, Serif; margin: 0pt 0">&nbsp;</P>

<P STYLE="font: 10pt Times New Roman, Times, Serif; margin: 0pt 0; text-indent: 20pt">(a)&#9;<U>Payment</U>. The Company shall pay to the Holder,
in cash on or before the Maturity Date, the original principal amount of this Debenture; <I>provided, </I>that if the Maturity
Date is not a Trading Day, such payment shall be made on the next succeeding Trading Day. The Payment that is due and which is
not paid on the Maturity Date shall bear interest until paid at the Default interest Rate.</P>

<P STYLE="font: 10pt Times New Roman, Times, Serif; margin: 0pt 0">&nbsp;</P>

<P STYLE="font: 10pt Times New Roman, Times, Serif; margin: 0pt 0"><I>3. <U>CONVERSION</U>.</I></P>

<P STYLE="font: 10pt Times New Roman, Times, Serif; margin: 0pt 0">&nbsp;</P>

<P STYLE="font: 10pt Times New Roman, Times, Serif; margin: 0pt 0; text-align: justify; text-indent: 20pt">(a)<U>&#9;Right to
Convert</U>. Subject to the conditions and limitations specifically provided herein, the Holder shall have the right to convert,
at any time and from time to time after the Issue Date, all or any part of the outstanding and unpaid principal amount and interest
of this Debenture into such number of Units as is determined in accordance with the terms hereof (a <I>&quot;<B>Conversion</B>&quot;).</I></P>

<P STYLE="font: 10pt Times New Roman, Times, Serif; margin: 0pt 0; text-align: justify">&nbsp;</P>

<P STYLE="font: 10pt Times New Roman, Times, Serif; margin: 0pt 0; text-align: justify; text-indent: 20pt">(b)&#9;<U>Conversion
Notice</U>. In order to convert principal of this Debenture, the Holder shall send by facsimile transmission, at any time prior
to 5:00 p.m., Pacific Time, on the Trading Day on which the Holder wishes to effect such Conversion (the <I>&quot;<B>Conversion
Date</B>&quot;), </I>a properly completed notice of conversion to the Company, in the form set forth on <U>Annex I</U> hereto,
stating the amount of principal and interest to he converted and a calculation of the number of Units issuable upon such Conversion
(a <I>&quot;<B>Conversion Notice</B>&quot;). </I>The Conversion Notice shall also state the name or names (if not the Holder)
in which the Units that are issuable on such Conversion shall be issued. The Holder shall not be required to physically surrender
this Debenture to the Company in order to effect a Conversion, unless such Conversion would represent payment in full of the Debenture.
The Company shall maintain a record showing, at any given time, the unpaid principal amount of this Debenture and the date of
each Conversion or other payment of principal hereof.</P>

<P STYLE="font: 10pt Times New Roman, Times, Serif; margin: 0pt 0; text-align: justify; text-indent: 20pt">&nbsp;</P>

<P STYLE="font: 10pt Times New Roman, Times, Serif; margin: 0pt 0; text-align: justify; text-indent: 20pt">(e)&#9;<U>Number of Conversion Shares;
Conversion Price</U>. The number of Units to be delivered by the Company pursuant to a Conversion shall be equal to the principal
amount of and this Debenture being converted <FONT STYLE="font-size: 10pt"><U>divided by</U></FONT> the Conversion Price.</P>

<P STYLE="font: 10pt Times New Roman, Times, Serif; margin: 0pt 0; text-align: justify; text-indent: 20pt">&nbsp;</P>

<P STYLE="font: 10pt Times New Roman, Times, Serif; margin: 0pt 0; text-indent: 20pt">(d)&#9;<U>Delivery of Units Upon Conversion</U>.
Upon receipt of a Conversion Notice, the Company shall, no later than the close of business on the fifth (5th) Trading Day following
the Conversion Date set forth in such Conversion Notice (the <I>&quot;<B>Delivery Date</B>&quot;), </I>issue and deliver or cause
to be delivered to the Holder the Units determined pursuant to paragraph 3(c) above. The Company shall effect delivery of Units
to the Holder no later than the close of business on such Delivery Date, if any Conversion would create a fractional Units, such
fractional Units shall be disregarded and the number of Units issuable upon such Conversion, in the aggregate, shall he the nearest
whole number of Units.</P>

<P STYLE="font: 10pt Times New Roman, Times, Serif; margin: 0pt 0">&nbsp;</P>

<P STYLE="font: 10pt Times New Roman, Times, Serif; margin: 0pt 0">&#9;4.&#9;<FONT STYLE="font-size: 10pt"><I><U>MISCELLANEOUS</U>.</I></FONT></P>

<P STYLE="font: 10pt Times New Roman, Times, Serif; margin: 0pt 0">&nbsp;</P>

<P STYLE="font: 10pt Times New Roman, Times, Serif; margin: 0pt 0">&nbsp;</P>

<P STYLE="font: 10pt Times New Roman, Times, Serif; margin: 0pt 0; text-align: justify; color: #0E0E0E; text-indent: 20pt">(a)&#9;<U>Failure to Exercise
Rights not Waiver</U>. No failure or delay on the part of the Holder in the exercise of any power, right or privilege hereunder
shall operate as a waiver thereof, nor shall any single or partial exercise of any such power, right or privilege preclude any
other or further exercise thereof. All rights and remedies of the Holder hereunder are cumulative and not exclusive of any rights
or remedies otherwise available.</P>

<P STYLE="font: 10pt Times New Roman, Times, Serif; margin: 0pt 0; text-align: justify; color: #0E0E0E; text-indent: 20pt">&nbsp;</P>

<P STYLE="font: 10pt Times New Roman, Times, Serif; margin: 0pt 0; text-align: justify; color: #0E0E0E; text-indent: 20pt">(b)<U>&#9;Notices</U>.
Any notice, demand or request required or permitted to be given by the Company or the Holder pursuant to the terms of this Debenture
shall he in writing and shall be deemed delivered (i) when delivered personally or by verifiable facsimile transmission, unless
such delivery is made on a day that is not a Trading Day, in which case such delivery will be deemed to be made on the next succeeding
Trading Day and (ii) on the next Trading Day after timely delivery to an overnight courier, addressed as follows:</P>

<P STYLE="font: 10pt Times New Roman, Times, Serif; margin: 0pt 0; text-align: justify; color: #0E0E0E">&nbsp;</P>

<P STYLE="font: 10pt Times New Roman, Times, Serif; margin: 0pt 0; color: #0E0E0E; text-indent: 20pt">(c)&#9;<U>Amendments</U>.
No amendment, modification or other change to, or waiver of any provision of, this Debenture may be made unless such amendment,
modification or change is set forth in writing and is signed by the Company and the Holder.</P>

<P STYLE="font: 10pt Times New Roman, Times, Serif; margin: 0pt 0; color: #0E0E0E; text-indent: 20pt">&nbsp;</P>

<P STYLE="font: 10pt Times New Roman, Times, Serif; margin: 0pt 0; color: #0E0E0E; text-indent: 20pt">(d)&#9;<U>Conversion. at
Maturity</U>. At any time on or after the Maturity Date, the Company may force Conversion of any remaining unpaid principal and
interest on the terms and conditions described in Section 3 herein.</P>

<P STYLE="font: 10pt Times New Roman, Times, Serif; margin: 0pt 0; color: #0E0E0E; text-indent: 20pt">&nbsp;</P>

<P STYLE="font: 10pt Times New Roman, Times, Serif; margin: 0pt 0; text-align: justify; color: #0E0E0E; text-indent: 20pt">(e)&#9;<U>Transfer
of Debenture</U>. The Holder may sell<FONT STYLE="font-family: Times New Roman, Times, Serif"><SUB>;</SUB></FONT> transfer or
otherwise dispose of all or any part of this <FONT STYLE="font-size: 10pt">Debenture (including without limitation </FONT>pursuant
to a pledge) to any <FONT STYLE="font-size: 10pt">person or entity as long as such </FONT>sale, transfer or disposition is the
subject of an effective registration statement under the Securities Act and applicable state securities laws, or is exempt from
registration thereunder. From and after the date of any such sale, transfer or disposition, the transferee hereof shall be deemed
to be the holder of a Debenture in the principal amount acquired by such transferee, and the Company shall, as promptly as practicable,
issue and deliver to such transferee a new Debenture identical in all respects to this Debenture, in the name of such transferee.
The Company shall be entitled to treat the original Holder as the holder of this entire Debenture unless and until it receives
written notice of the sale, transfer or disposition hereof.</P>

<P STYLE="font: 10pt Times New Roman, Times, Serif; margin: 0pt 0; text-align: justify; color: #0E0E0E; text-indent: 20pt">&nbsp;</P>

<P STYLE="font: 10pt Times New Roman, Times, Serif; margin: 0pt 0; text-align: justify; color: #0E0E0E; text-indent: 20pt">(f)&#9;<U>Lost
or Stolen Debenture</U>. Upon receipt by the Company of evidence of the loss, theft, destruction or mutilation of this Debenture,
and (in the case of loss, theft or destruction) of indemnity or security reasonably satisfactory to the Company, and upon surrender
and cancellation of the Debenture, if mutilated, the Company shall execute and deliver to the Holder a new Debenture identical
in all respects to this Debenture.</P>

<P STYLE="font: 10pt Times New Roman, Times, Serif; margin: 0pt 0; text-align: justify; color: #0E0E0E">&nbsp;</P>

<P STYLE="font: 10pt Times New Roman, Times, Serif; margin: 0pt 0; text-align: justify; color: #0E0E0E"></P>

<P STYLE="font: 10pt Times New Roman, Times, Serif; margin: 0pt 0; text-align: justify; color: #0E0E0E; text-indent: 20pt">(g)<U>&#9;Governing
Law</U>. This Debenture shall be governed by and construed in accordance with the laws of the State of California applicable to
contracts made and to be performed entirely within the State of California.</P>

<P STYLE="font: 10pt Times New Roman, Times, Serif; margin: 0pt 0; text-align: justify; color: #0E0E0E; text-indent: 20pt">&nbsp;</P>

<P STYLE="font: 10pt Times New Roman, Times, Serif; margin: 0pt 0; text-align: justify; color: #0E0E0E; text-indent: 20pt">(h)&#9;<U>Successors
and Assigns</U>. The terms and conditions of this Debenture shall inure to the benefit of  and be binding upon the
respective successors (whether by merger or otherwise) and permitted assigns of the Company and the Holder. The Company may
not assign its rights or obligations under this Debenture except as specifically required or permitted pursuant to the terms
hereof.</P>

<P STYLE="font: 10pt Times New Roman, Times, Serif; margin: 0pt 0; text-align: justify; color: #0E0E0E; text-indent: 20pt">&nbsp;</P>

<P STYLE="font: 10pt Times New Roman, Times, Serif; margin: 0pt 0; text-align: justify; color: #0E0E0E; text-indent: 20pt">(i)&#9;<U>Usury</U>. This
Debenture is subject to the express condition that at no time shall the Company be obligated or required to pay interest hereunder
at a rate which could subject the Holder to either civil or criminal liability as a result of being in excess of the maximum interest
rate which the Company is permitted by applicable law to contract or agree to pay. If by the terms of this Debenture, the Company
is at any time required or obligated to pay interest hereunder at a rate in excess of such maximum rate, the rate of interest under
this Debenture shall be deemed to be immediately reduced to such maximum rate and the interest payable shall be computed at such
maximum rate and all prior interest payments in excess of such maximum rate shall be applied and shall he deemed to have been payments
in reduction of the principal balance or this Debenture.</P>

<P STYLE="font: 10pt Times New Roman, Times, Serif; margin: 0pt 0; text-align: justify; color: #0E0E0E">&nbsp;</P>

<P STYLE="font: 10pt Times New Roman, Times, Serif; margin: 0pt 0; text-align: justify; color: #0E0E0E">IN WITNESS WHEREOF, the
Company has caused this Debenture to be signed in its name by its duly authorized officer on the date first above written.</P>

<P STYLE="font: 10pt Times New Roman, Times, Serif; margin: 0pt 0; text-align: center; color: #0E0E0E"><B><U>NOTICE OF CONVERSION</U></B></P>

<P STYLE="font: 10pt Times New Roman, Times, Serif; margin: 0pt 0; text-align: center; color: #0E0E0E">&nbsp;</P>

<P STYLE="font: 10pt Times New Roman, Times, Serif; margin: 0pt 0; text-align: justify; color: #0E0E0E">The undersigned hereby
elects to convert principal of and/or interest accrued on the Unsecured Convertible Debenture (the &quot;Debenture&quot;) issued
by VIRAL GENETICS, INC. (the <U>&quot;Corporation&quot;)</U> into Units of the Company according to the terms and conditions of
the Debenture. Capitalized terms used herein and not otherwise defined shall have the respective meanings set forth in the Debenture.</P>
